summary: Wenatchee NF L-4 lookout site near Snoqualmie Pass: 1937 tower, 1948 timber replacement, removed 1965-1968; footings and wreckage remain.

facts.design: L-4 lookout tower; 40-foot treated timber L-4 tower (1948 replacement)
facts.status_note: Both lookout towers are gone; footings and wreckage remain on the summit

access.note: Reached by Roaring Ridge Road from I-90 Exit 62 and a minor trail; no closure is described in the sources read, but no source confirms current rules

visit.drive_up: Take I-90 Exit 62, turn onto the unsigned Roaring Ridge Road and follow it about 3.5 miles to the end; high clearance recommended
visit.trail_note: Minor trail up the north ridge from the end of the road

events.note: First L-4 tower; a 1934 panorama suggests something stood on the summit earlier
Panoramas dated August 10, 1934 show views from a platform 40 feet above the ground
Replaced by a 40-foot treated timber L-4 tower; willhiteweb.com gives 1948 or 1958
Register says the 1948 tower was removed in 1965; other sources give 1968
firelookout.com says destroyed in 1968; One Hike A Week says removals on the peak took place as late as 1968
Registered September 28, 2010; nominated by Irene Potter

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says the 1948 tower was removed in 1965; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1968; One Hike A Week says removals as late as 1968; willhiteweb.com says 1965 or 1968. The story gives the range and names each source.

Register and firelookout.com date the 40-foot timber tower to 1948; willhiteweb.com says 1948 or 1958 and notes the USGS listed the lookout as new in 1958. The story gives 1948 and mentions the alternative.
Register and firelookout.com date the first L-4 tower to 1937; willhiteweb.com cites August 1934 panoramas showing a platform, suggesting an earlier structure.

notes_for_editor: Removal date conflicts (1965 vs 1968) and replacement date (1948 vs 1958) are stated as conflicts in the story. Access 'public' rests on route descriptions only; no closure or current-rules source found. No staffing, fire, or NRHP sources found. Trip-report and search-snippet pages (WTA, Mountaineers, snoqualmielookouts.org) were not used for claims. The weebly page had only a county listing for this site.
